resources.string: Choose which tools external AI clients can see and which calls need your approval
%1$d of %2$d tools are open to external clients
The local MCP server is off. These settings take effect once you turn it on.
Editing tools stay closed until “Allow file changes” is on.
By default, AIDE+ asks you each time an external client calls one of these tools (AIDE+ must be in the foreground). Tap a tool and set it to “Automatic” to stop asking.
Restore the default access for every tool?
Turn on “Allow file changes” in the MCP server settings first
